concepts.name: Spatial
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exceptionally refined, high-fidelity desktop website design screenshot, landscape 1536x1024. The image is the actual flat webpage filling the canvas, no browser frame, no device, no perspective mockup, no design-board labels outside the site. Brand is ORBIT AERIALS, a Kuwait-based construction progress documentation, aerial mapping, 360 walkthrough and handover media service. This is a new visual concept, intentionally different from a conventional corporate hero with text on left and a construction photo on right. Use exact legible text, clear layout hierarchy and buildable interface details. No fake metrics, client names, testimonials, badges, certifications, SaaS dashboards, or stock drone-product renders. Photography and 3D content are illustrative. No giant drone product in the center: the construction projects and their visual documentation are the subject. Use a simple text brand, no invented logo symbol.
DIRECTION: SPATIAL. Ultra-minimal futuristic luxury product presentation, immaculate milky white and silver-grey, black typography, one small cobalt accent. Bright neutral, nearly shadowless atmosphere. An image-led sculptural composition, no dark backgrounds, no boxed feature cards. Font is a clean highly refined geometric sans, light/medium weight, not chunky. A tiny centered pill-like nav floats with generous margins near top, text brand 'ORBIT AERIALS' left outside capsule, navigation 'Services  About  Contact' in capsule, small plain 'Log In' right.

Centered hero headline at y160 in two very balanced lines: 'Your entire site.' / 'In perspective.' in black, around 65px, with generous whitespace. Small caption directly beneath: 'Aerial documentation. Spatial understanding.' and compact cobalt pill CTA 'Explore the possibilities'. Beneath, dominating the lower 55% of the composition: an enormous exquisitely rendered photogrammetry DIGITAL TWIN model of a modern Gulf construction project, not a drone. A detailed cut-out floating rectangular section of ground with incomplete concrete structures, one small crane, streets, sand, and landscaping, viewed isometrically like a beautifully scanned physical architectural model. Actual textured material at left transitions into delicate silver-white point-cloud at right, showing imagery becoming usable spatial intelligence. Subtle soft contact shadow on white floor. Absolutely no chart interface, labels over model or fake real-time numbers. At very bottom clean single line section heading 'A clearer view of every stage.' and three small understated service links 'Document progress', 'Explore in 360', 'Map your site'. White space is part of composition. The result should feel as simple, expensive and polished as a top-tier premium technology brand.

DIRECTION: SIGNAL. Radical bold graphic identity. Saturated electric ultramarine blue #223DEA as the page's base and pale acid yellow #E4ED85 as the single contrasting brand color. Under left text 'Construction, seen with clarity.' and one yellow capsule 'Discover Orbit' with small dark-blue arrow. A deliberately offset horizontal aerial-photo ribbon crosses the LOWER HALF of the hero around y430, composed of three touching real photo crops with clean rectangular edges: top-down sand and concrete foundations, near-oblique new commercial buildings, and geometrical 360-style building interior. Ribbon goes from x280 to right edge, approx 360px height, architecturally beautiful near-monochrome photographs creating a sharp contrast against blue. No card framing or captions over photos. Blue and yellow expanses above and below are strong compositions, not a photo-background hero. At bottom y840 a yellow background panel containing dark blue large short text 'Progress. In full view.' plus small right-aligned 'Drone capture / Time-lapse / 360 walkthroughs'. Bold Swiss graphic-design sensibility with original purposeful alignment, lively and contemporary without looking like a toy.

Brand is ORBIT AERIALS, a Kuwait-based construction progress documentation, aerial mapping, 360 walkthrough and handover media service. This is a new visual concept, intentionally different from a conventional corporate hero with text on left and a construction photo on right. Use exact legible text, clear layout hierarchy and buildable interface details. No fake metrics, client names, testimonials, badges, certifications, SaaS dashboards, or stock drone-product renders. Photography and 3D content are illustrative. No giant drone product in the center: the construction projects and their visual documentation are the subject. Use a simple text brand, no invented logo symbol.
DIRECTION: BLUEPRINT. A sophisticated spatial-engineering website, entire page deep black-green #102825 with pale mint #D5E7D7 type and a restrained fresh mint accent. Tiny precise monospace metadata plus elegant medium-weight narrow sans headlines. Give this a deeply technical, quiet, confident design language. The scene is a construction documentation consultancy with geospatial expertise, not a software subscription product.

Layout deliberately unconventional: a slim LEFT navigation rail 210px wide runs entire height, with 'ORBIT' then smaller 'AERIALS' at top, spaced vertical nav labels 'Overview', 'Services', 'About', 'Contact', and bottom a simple outline rectangular 'Plan a capture' button. Separating rail from page with one thin mint structural line is fine. Main canvas begins x250. Top-left a restrained 52px headline 'Understand' / 'every dimension.' and 18px copy below 'Aerial capture and spatial insight for your project.' Clear accessible contrast. Hero imagery at upper-right and across center is an enormous elegant isometric architectural SURVEY MODEL of a real-looking construction district. The model is highly detailed technical geometry: pale mint fine wireframe buildings, cranes, terrain contours, and sparse point-cloud texture on black-green negative space. This is an intentionally illustrative design motif for GIS deliverables, not a fake live dashboard. Topography and measurement lines belong to the model, never decorative full-screen grid or crosshairs. No fabricated numeric measurements, bounding-box targets, activity feed or fake stats. At image bottom a tiny functional caption 'Illustrative spatial model'.

Lower portion below model/headline is a precisely composed 3-column typographic service index without boxes: 'Capture' / 'Map' / 'Understand', each with one exact short descriptor 'Consistent aerial records.', 'Site context in detail.', 'Visuals that support decisions.'. A final plain text link 'Explore our services' is visible. Make the hero/model feel like an exhibit in an elite engineering studio, original and spatial, gorgeous microtypography and excellent breathing room.

Then short human copy 'A considered record of the places taking shape.' and an understated underlined text CTA 'Explore our perspective'. Right 58% is an asymmetrical photographic gallery, NOT a single photo. A tall portrait photo of an elegantly incomplete concrete building frame taken from elevated close angle starts x760,y140, height500,width310. Beside it at x1100,y330 is a smaller wide aerial photo of Gulf roads and pale desert construction geometry, height220,width345. At x540,y600 another medium horizontal photo of a completed modern facade at sunset begins the lower gallery. Photography has muted warm/cool contrast and genuine concrete texture; beautifully considered crops, crisp corners, broad margins. No fake project labels, invented case studies or credits. Actual useful small captions can be 'Progress documentation', 'Aerial perspectives', 'Handover films'. At bottom left small serif text 'From a first idea' / 'to a lasting record.' The design breathes, feels intimate and curated rather than corporate, unusually stylish but easy to navigate.

DIRECTION: IMMERSIVE. Entire homepage is an edge-to-edge three-panel project experience, minimal navigation, very little marketing text. Imagine a premium film portfolio combined with a visual service browser. Truly different from a headline hero above sections. Top 90px is a solid off-white strip: bold small black text brand 'ORBIT AERIALS' at x48, centered sentence 'A clearer view of your project.', right nav 'About' and black rounded 'Get in touch' button.

All panels have the same height. Left panel shows spectacular high angle photorealistic Gulf construction site with pale sand, concrete structure and complex crane shadows, daylight. Middle panel shows beautiful warm unfinished architectural interior with tall arches and exposed concrete columns, captured wide-angle, expressing immersive 360 site exploration. Right panel shows a crisply finished contemporary office facade at blue hour seen obliquely from a drone, expressing cinematic handover.

In each panel place a LARGE typography label toward the bottom but in a clean small frosted-glass panel that spans almost panel width with 24px external margins. These frosted panels must be beautifully restrained with real translucency, internal highlights, gentle 16px corners, excellent readability, a solid-text title and a small white circular arrow button on right. Exact left title 'Track the build.' and descriptor 'Progress documentation & time-lapse'. Middle title 'Step inside.' with descriptor '360 walkthroughs'. Right title 'Tell the story.' and descriptor 'Handover media'. Break titles naturally to fit narrow columns. No other card UI. Much of the photography stays unobstructed. The distinctive homepage IS the service selection, immersive, cinematic but daylight-led and tactile. No big headline at upper left, no black-and-gold palette, no generic footer, no fake project titles, no carousel pagination. Make a genuinely sophisticated interactive portfolio starting screen with exquisite art direction.

concepts.name: Orbital
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate one original, daring, exquisitely polished high-fidelity website screenshot for ORBIT AERIALS, a construction aerial documentation, mapping and 360 walkthrough service based in Kuwait. User explicitly wants a DISTINCTIVE unusual website, has rejected conventional corporate homepage designs. Create an art-directed interactive portfolio landing screen whose defining navigation uses an ORBIT around an aerial construction view. Flat full-screen landscape 1536x1024 screenshot, fills entire canvas, not a laptop, no browser chrome, no perspective board.

Concept name is ORBITAL, do not print concept label. Black-cherry almost-black #171318 background throughout, very pale pink-white typography #F0E6EB, soft coral #EF9C92 as small functional accent only. Absolutely no navy/gold, traditional hero split, rectangular photo, dashboard, feature boxes, neon or glow. Refined futuristic but mature design. A micro header top-left 'ORBIT AERIALS' and top-right minimal 'About' 'Contact' and a tiny outlined 'Start a project' capsule.

Main visual is one enormous perfectly circular portal containing a highly realistic top-down aerial photo of a coastal Gulf construction development. Circle around 650px diameter centered x950 y500, gentle physical depth, site geometry and pale roads and sand making beautiful abstract architectural patterns. NOT Earth, not a planet, no stars, not a lens or drone hardware. Outside this circular aerial view, exactly one thin elliptical route elegantly traces a perspective orbit at a 20-degree incline, ranging from x490 to1470 y200 to800. The orbit is purposeful SERVICE NAVIGATION, not a random sci-fi graphic: four labeled small solid soft-coral circular buttons are placed on this one line at useful positions outside the photo boundary. Each has a readable text label in pale pink nearby, exact labels 'Progress', 'Mapping', '360 tours', 'Films'. Strong deliberate composition. NO numeric coordinates or decorative technical symbols. At one orbital stop there is a tiny rectangular photographic preview of building interior, appearing as a hover example, with a clean thin coral edge. This is a plausible interactive hero presentation, carefully organized without overlaps.

On the left, ample black-cherry negative space, a beautifully set medium-size headline in an elegant ultra-wide sans-serif, around 50px, TWO lines: 'A different' / 'perspective.' Below it a short very readable 17px descriptor 'Explore every dimension of your project.' and a pale-coral pill button 'Explore Orbit' with dark text. Near bottom left a MASSIVE ultra-wide lowercase 'orbit' wordmark 220px tall, partly cropped by lower edge for expressive intentional brand typography, but clearly readable. It occupies lower left half and does not overlap nav labels. A small right-bottom text 'Aerial documentation. Visual intelligence.' Very tightly controlled negative space, asymmetric balance, original branded spatial navigation. Make this look like a real high-budget award-caliber creative technology website with exquisite typography. No invented metrics, clients, claims, testimonials. All image scenes are illustrative.
